description: Header file defining the RenderTargetVk class, a lightweight wrapper around Vulkan renderable resources, including methods for initialization, access, and management of Vulkan images and views within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: RenderTargetVk
classes.description: A lightweight class representing a Vulkan render target, managing Image and ImageView pointers, and providing methods for rendering operations and resource management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the render target with Vulkan image and view helpers, and sets level and layer indices.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the render target, clearing its state.

methods.name: onColorDraw
methods.description: Performs color drawing operations on the render target.

methods.name: onDepthStencilDraw
methods.description: Performs depth/stencil drawing operations on the render target.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns a reference to the Vulkan ImageHelper.

methods.name: getImageForRead
methods.description: Prepares the image for reading, transitioning layout as needed.

methods.name: getImageView
methods.description: Retrieves the image view for the render target.

methods.name: updateSwapchainImage
methods.description: Updates the render target with a new swapchain image and views.

methods.name: flushStagedUpdates
methods.description: Flushes any staged updates to the render target.

methods.name: onImageViewGraphAccess
methods.description: Handles access to the image view in the graph.
